alignment_method: hybrid: tfidf shortlist -> grade+keyword rerank -> LLM curation (Claude Sonnet)
notes: High-school resume project. Career-prep writing for a specific audience. Most content-writing objectives map to W.9-10.2 (informative/explanatory) and W.9-10.4 (clear coherent writing). Many logistical formatting objectives are intentionally unaligned.

objectives.title: Headings
objectives.description: Insert five section headings styled as heading3.
objectives.note: Logistical document structure. No ELA standard applies.

objectives.title: File Name
objectives.description: Rename your file using the naming convention.

objectives.title: Your Name
objectives.description: Add your full name at the top of the document.

objectives.title: Contact Details
objectives.description: Add phone, email, and location with a delimiter between elements.

alignments.rationale: Task-appropriate formatting is part of producing writing for a clear purpose and audience, though this item is largely logistical.

objectives.title: Insert Section: {{var:OBJECTIVE}}
objectives.description: Insert a horizontal line and section break before the OBJECTIVE heading.
objectives.note: Logistical document structure. No ELA standard applies.

objectives.title: Write Summary Section
objectives.description: Write a concise summary statement (2-4 sentences) describing yourself as a candidate.

alignments.rationale: Write informative/explanatory texts to examine and convey complex ideas — the summary statement is a compressed piece of informative self-description.
Introduce a topic and organize complex ideas — the summary must open the resume by framing who you are.
Produce clear, coherent writing appropriate to task, purpose, and audience — a resume summary is highly audience-specific.

objectives.title: Insert Section: {{var:EDUCATION}}
objectives.description: Insert a horizontal line and section break before the EDUCATION heading.

objectives.title: High School
objectives.description: Add your high school name, location, and graduation date.

alignments.rationale: Producing writing appropriate to purpose/format. Mostly mechanical data entry.

objectives.title: Insert Section: {{var:EXPERIENCE}}
objectives.description: Insert a horizontal line and section break before the EXPERIENCE heading.

objectives.title: Experience #1
objectives.description: Add a role or position with location, dates, and bullet-point accomplishments.

alignments.rationale: Develop the topic with well-chosen, relevant facts — this is exactly the work of writing strong experience bullets.
Use precise language and domain-specific vocabulary — strong resume bullets lean on active verbs and precise nouns.
Produce clear, coherent writing appropriate to task and audience.

objectives.title: Experience #2
objectives.description: Add a second experience with the same structure as #1.

alignments.rationale: Same as Experience #1 — develop content with relevant, well-chosen details.
Precise language and domain-specific vocabulary.
Clear, coherent writing for the stated task.

objectives.title: Insert Section: {{var:SKILLS}}
objectives.description: Insert a horizontal line and section break before the SKILLS heading.

alignments.rationale: Use technology to produce and publish — inserting and populating a structured table in a word processor touches the production-with-technology standard.
Acquire and use accurate general academic and domain-specific words and phrases — the skills list forces precise vocabulary choice.

objectives.title: Insert Section: Custom
objectives.description: Insert a horizontal line and section break before a custom heading.

objectives.title: Custom Section Content
objectives.description: Use AI and/or the internet to research a custom section topic and write content.

alignments.rationale: Conduct short research projects to answer a question or solve a problem — the task explicitly directs research before writing.
Gather relevant information from multiple authoritative sources and integrate it — this is the AI-and-internet research step.
Write informative/explanatory texts — the output is a written informative section.

objectives.title: Summary and Formatting (Teacher Review)
objectives.description: Review summary section has all required elements; check formatting.

alignments.rationale: Teacher is checking the intro/framing quality of the summary.
Checking clear, coherent writing appropriate to task, purpose, audience.
Revising — the teacher review step invites strengthening the writing.

objectives.title: Education and Experience (Teacher Review)
objectives.description: Verify education and experience sections are complete with required elements.

alignments.rationale: Teacher checks whether content has well-chosen, relevant details.
Check that writing is clear and appropriate for a resume context.
Conventions of standard English grammar and usage in finished draft.
Capitalization, punctuation, and spelling.

objectives.title: Skills (Teacher Review)
objectives.description: Review skills table is correctly formatted and populated.

alignments.rationale: Technology-based production of the skills table.
Checking use of accurate academic and domain-specific vocabulary in skills list.
